name: wikipedia-cypress-tests
description: Portfolio/reference Cypress automation project exercising Wikipedia: Page Object Model, CI smoke suite, and Mochawesome reporting.
author: Stanislav Mokshyn <https://github.com/testomut>

scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('cypress.env.json')){console.log('cypress.env.json already exists - leaving it as is.');}else{fs.copyFileSync('cypress.env.example.json','cypress.env.json');console.log('Created cypress.env.json - fill in a disposable test account, see SECURITY.md.');}"
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run cypress:run
